changeSet.author: sondos
changeSet.sql: CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW reports.vwvitalsigns AS SELECT vs.id, vs.patient_id, vs.encounter_id, vs.blood_pressure_systolic, vs.blood_pressure_diastolic, vs.measurement_site, vs.heart_rate, vs.temperature, vs.oxygen_saturation, vs.respiratory_rate, vs.notes, vs.is_triage, vs.created_by, vs.is_active, vs.created_date, vs.last_modified_by, vs.last_modified_date FROM public.vital_signs vs;

changeSet.author: sondos
changeSet.sql: GRANT USAGE ON SCHEMA reports TO report_user;
GRANT SELECT ON reports.vwvitalsigns TO report_user;

rollback.sql: REVOKE SELECT ON reports.vwvitalsigns FROM report_user;
